LanguageData.LP_Research_AetherArmor.label: aether power armor
LanguageData.LP_Research_AetherArmor.description: Weave mithril into the joints and servo structure of power armor and replace ordinary batteries with an aether core. Allows crafting the "artificer power armor" and "artificer rebreather helm" at the fabrication bench.
LanguageData.LP_Research_AetherBastion.label: oathbound bastion armor
LanguageData.LP_Research_AetherBastion.description: Cast whole breastplates and pauldrons of adamantine and engrave them with oath runes to make the heaviest power armor. Allows crafting the "oathbound bastion armor" and "bastion great helm" at the fabrication bench.
